newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quotes firm amid cargo strength.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quotes firm amid cargo strength.

text.p: Singapore's bunker quotes stayed at firm levels on Wednesday on expectations for cargo strength to continue, traders said.
The 180-cst fuel oil was traded at $100 per tonne on Tuesday, $1.50 per tonne higher from last week. "Suppliers are expecting the cargo market to remain firm," said one trader.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $106/$107 per tonne and the 380-cst was at about $100/$101. MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $190/$193 and $205/$210 respectively.
